usefulness.rationale: The dossier contains no claims — the dossier array is empty. The only content is identity anchors and two pre-flagged unjustified conclusions, which cannot substitute for sourced statements. Because no claims exist, no dossier statement can be assessed as overclaiming its cited passage; the two listed unjustified conclusions do not appear in any dossier claim to match. Remaining questions scored 0 because the empty dossier neither states nor implies what it does not know — it simply says nothing. Judgment is fairly clear-cut given the absence of content, so uncertain is not set.
